title: Fine-grained admin sentinel: selective egress policies and public-link lockdown
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a unified 'Admin Sentinel' capability that exposes fine-grained compliance toggles for org admins. The feature bundles selective egress policies (IP allowlists & region limits), a hard-disable for public shareable links, and tiered data export controls. This ticket covers backend policy enforcement hooks, audit logging instrumentation, RBAC v2 permission checks, and Console UI surfaces. We must ensure SSO/SAML session and SCIM provisioning signals are respected, and that every toggle action emits structured audit events for retention and downstream SIEM ingestion.
background: Current admin controls are fragmented: IP allowlisting lives in a lower-level network config, public share controls are client-side toggles, and export controls are only partially enforced during UI flows. RBAC v2 introduces role-scoped policy evaluation which allows us to centralize enforcement. Compliance teams have requested immutable admin-level locks and an audit trail with exportable events for SOC review.
acceptance_criteria: Org admins can set an IP allowlist at org-level; requests outside the list are rejected with 403 and a structured audit event is emitted
A new "public_link_disabled" org toggle that prevents generation of public share links; existing links can be invalidated via bulk revoke
Data export control with three modes: allow, require-admin-approval, deny. Mode changes are versioned and produce audit logs
All toggle changes and enforcement decisions produce structured audit logs (JSON) with fields: actor_id, org_id, toggle_name, previous_value, new_value, timestamp, request_context
RBAC v2 policy evaluation used for all admin endpoints so non-admin users cannot flip toggles; integration tests cover role permutations
Console surfaces (Settings -> Compliance) show state, last-changed-by, and a change history, and provide bulk actions for link revocation
End-to-end tests simulate SSO/SAML session attributes (e.g., is_admin=true) and SCIM group sync reflecting RBAC role changes
Telemetry: expose dashboard metrics for toggle flips, failed enforcement attempts, and audit event volume
tasks: Backend: add policy layer hook to request pipeline to consult org-level compliance policies
Backend: implement org toggle storage with immutability/versioning and last-changed metadata
Backend: emit structured audit events to the audit-service topic; schema v2.1
RBAC: ensure permission required for toggle change maps to new RBAC v2 'org:admin:settings' permission
Console: design and implement Compliance page with controls and history table
E2E: write integration tests for enforcement paths and admin UI flows
Docs: create runbook for incident response when toggles cause service disruption
Security review: schedule gated code review and threat modeling session
risks: Misconfigured allowlists could block legitimate traffic — need emergency bypass path for SRE
Toggle flips may have wide blast radius; we need staged rollout and canary restrictions
Audit volume growth could increase storage costs — retention policy required
SSO session claims inconsistencies could lead to authorization gaps; must validate against SCIM-provisioned roles
implementation_notes: Policy evaluation should be deterministic and idempotent; use same evaluation layer used by runtime routing
Store toggle versions in the org config table with a monotonic revision id to aid rollbacks
Audit events should be human-readable in Console but structured for SIEM (send to Splunk/Datadog via audit-forwarder)
Public link invalidation will be implemented via signature rotation and a bulk revocation index to avoid touching object storage
Provide a 'read-only enforcement' mode for 30 days where toggle changes are recorded but not enforced to collect signal
testing_plan: Unit tests for policy evaluation logic and RBAC permission checks
Integration tests that assert blocked requests when IP not in allowlist
E2E smoke test: UI flip -> backend log -> enforcement observed on subsequent requests
Load test: simulate 10k toggle reads/sec to validate policy cache performance
Regression test: ensure existing sharing flows are unaffected when toggles are disabled
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal dogfood with 'read-only enforcement' for 2 weeks
Phase 1: opt-in early access (beta) for selected customers with dedicated support
Phase 2: general availability with 7-day staged rollout per org and automatic rollback on key metric anomalies
Emergency: SRE escape hatch that sets enforcement to 'off' for a single org for up to 1 hour with 2-person approval
